At coalescence Phi-q has a cubic zero and U quartically flat; integration of the local quadratic log-derivative gives window coefficient C=.27718120856 multiplying (z-z*)^(3/2). Independent SymPy discriminant/log derivative identities and five distinct two-ring witnesses passed. Physical nonideal models not included.
